result.instructions: Tools for Stytch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the user with the email address ada@example.com and show her login methods."; "Which sessions are active for user-test-… right now?"; "End the session with session_id session-… because the device was lost.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stytch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stytch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stytch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stytch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. stytch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stytch_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Search the users of this Stytch project, with optional filters and cursor paging. Returns results (user_id, emails, name, status, created_at) and results_metadata (next_cursor, total). Stytch warns this search is slow and not for login flows. Stytch API: POST /v1/users/search.

cursor.description: Cursor from results_metadata.next_cursor, to get the next page.

filters.description: Filters. All of them must match (operator AND). Leave empty to return all results.

filter_name.description: Filter name from the Stytch search reference, for example organization_slugs.

filter_value.description: Value to match. Use a list of strings for list filters.

tools.name: stytch_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by user_id: emails, phone numbers, providers (login methods), status, is_locked, roles and metadata. Stytch API: GET /v1/users/{user_id}.

user_id.description: The user id, for example from a search tool.

tools.name: stytch_list_user_sessions
tools.title: List a user's sessions
tools.description: List the active sessions of one user: session_id, started_at, last_accessed_at, expires_at, authentication factors and roles. Stytch API: GET /v1/sessions?user_id=.

user_id.description: The user id, for example from a search tool.

tools.name: stytch_revoke_session
tools.title: Revoke a session
tools.description: Revoke one session by session_id. Its session tokens stop working at once, so the user must sign in again. Use only when the user asks to end that session. Stytch API: POST /v1/sessions/revoke.

session_id.description: The session id, for example from a search tool.

tools.name: stytch_search_organizations
tools.title: Search B2B organizations
tools.description: Search the B2B organizations of this project (needs a B2B-enabled project), with optional filters and cursor paging. Returns organizations (organization_id, organization_name, organization_slug, auth_methods) and results_metadata. Stytch API: POST /v1/b2b/organizations/search.

cursor.description: Cursor from results_metadata.next_cursor, to get the next page.

filters.description: Filters. All of them must match (operator AND). Leave empty to return all results.

filter_name.description: Filter name from the Stytch search reference, for example organization_slugs.

filter_value.description: Value to match. Use a list of strings for list filters.

tools.name: stytch_get_organization
tools.title: Get a B2B organization
tools.description: Get one B2B organization by organization_id: name, slug, SSO and auth method settings, and metadata. Stytch API: GET /v1/b2b/organizations/{organization_id}.

organization_id.description: The organization id, for example from a search tool.

tools.name: stytch_search_members
tools.title: Search B2B members
tools.description: Search the members of one or more B2B organizations. Needs at least one organization_id. Returns members (member_id, email_address, name, status, roles), organizations and results_metadata. Stytch warns this search is slow and not for login flows. Stytch API: POST /v1/b2b/organizations/members/search.

organization_ids.description: One or more organization ids to search within.

cursor.description: Cursor from results_metadata.next_cursor, to get the next page.

filters.description: Filters. All of them must match (operator AND). Leave empty to return all results.

filter_name.description: Filter name from the Stytch search reference, for example organization_slugs.
